limitations: The common measured stop gate remains active. Zero bound-stage failures is conditional on reaching that stage, not proof that the local policy is perfect. Actual model latency and subsequent physical histories differ across conditions. No formal trajectory is reused for training or selection. A successful stop may occur immediately upon binding before another physical step is logged. Absence of a logged bound step alone is not evidence of success without binding.
